clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau was asked why so many people test low on vitamin D and other hormones.

His answer starts simple: most people aren't getting enough sun. Vitamin D is one of the most commonly deficient nutrients he's seen in years of looking at people's numbers.

Kevin Trudeau's view: before reaching for another bottle, look at the basics first - daylight and real food are part of the equation most labs never ask about.

Small changes outdoors can move a number a supplement alone sometimes can't.

When's the last time you actually checked your vitamin D level?
